considerations: Identify the specific blocking policy in sign-in details.
Look for later successful grants for the same app and user.
description: Find device-code attempts failing Conditional Access.

evidence.claim: Microsoft demonstrated in a lab that device code phishing can expose sessions used by coding agents, and noted earlier device-code phishing campaigns. The demonstration is distinct from observed incidents.

expected_output: One row per matching event in tabular mode. A match supports triage.

history.summary: Created evidence-backed hunt and validated all supported variants.

hypothesis: Find device-code attempts failing Conditional Access.
performance: Time filter first, then table-specific predicates and a narrow projection.
scope: Evidence review, static checks, Microsoft Kusto syntax and schema analysis. Engine and workspace execution not run.
title: Device-Code Attempts Blocked by Conditional Access

1.json:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode" and ConditionalAccessStatus =~ "failure"
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName, IPAddress, Location, ResultType, ConditionalAccessStatus
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| summarize Results = make_list(pack_all())
| project JSON = tostring(Results)
